Q0.text: Right now, do you have any of these?

answers.skin_spot: A spot or mole on the skin
answers.bowel: Bowel changes or blood in stool
answers.screening: No symptoms, I want a colon cancer screening

Q2.text: Did it start with an injury, like a fall, a twist or a hit?

Q3.text: How long has it been going on?

Q4.text: Have you already tried about 6 weeks of physical therapy, exercises or medicines, and it's still bad?

Q5.text: Does it catch, lock, click with pain, or feel like it slips out?

answers.painful_catch: Yes, catching or clicking that hurts, or slipping
answers.painless_click: It clicks, but it doesn't hurt

Q6.text: Can you lift your arm overhead by yourself? If someone else lifts it for you, does it go up?

answers.weak_lift_only: I can't lift it well myself, but it goes up with help
answers.lifts_fine: It lifts fine, it just hurts

Q7.text: Does pain, tingling or numbness travel down your arm or leg?

answers.changing: It's changing in size, shape or color
answers.different: It looks different from my other moles
answers.none: None of these, I just want it checked

Q11.text: Any of these: trouble swallowing, losing weight without trying, black or bloody stool, been told you're anemic, or vomiting that won't stop?

Q12.text: Have you taken an acid-reducing medicine (like omeprazole) every day for about 8 weeks?

answers.yes_still_bad: Yes, and it's still bad (or came back when I stopped)

Q13.text: Any of these: a positive home stool test, a parent, sibling or child with colon cancer, inflammatory bowel disease, or polyps found before? And when was your last colonoscopy?

answers.positive_stool_test: My home stool test came back positive
answers.higher_risk_history: Family history, bowel disease, or polyps before
answers.normal_within_10y: I had a normal colonoscopy less than 10 years ago

Q14.text: What kind of plan do you have?

answers.hmo_referral_required: HMO / my plan needs a referral
